body.name: \(\mathcal A_n^{\mathrm{wit}}\)
body.def: For every \(x\in\{1,2\}\), \(z\in\{0,1\}\), and \(r\in\{0,1,2\}\), the table has exactly four rows \[(x,z,1,1,1,1,r,r;1/48),\quad(x,z,0,0,1,1,r,r;1/48),\] \[(x,z,0,1,1,1,r,r;m^{\mathrm{wit}}_{n,x}/12),\quad(x,z,0,1,0,0,r,r;(1/2-m^{\mathrm{wit}}_{n,x})/12).\] Each tuple lists \((X_{ni},Z_{ni},D_{ni}(0),D_{ni}(1),S_{ni}(0),S_{ni}(1),Y_{ni}(0),Y_{ni}(1);\text{probability})\), and every tuple not displayed has probability zero.
